name: riverpod_generator
summary: The Riverpod code generator that turns annotated declarations into generated providers and related boilerplate.
advantages: Keeps generated provider APIs aligned with Riverpod
tradeoffs: Requires a code-generation step and generated files
Version compatibility tracks Dart/analyzer changes closely
recommendedFor: Riverpod projects that accept code generation
Projects that want annotation-driven providers and less provider boilerplate

verification.reason: Current pub.dev metadata and Riverpod documentation are sufficient; 4.0.9 is the current stable version found.
